name: noise-texture
title: Noise Texture
blurb: SVG-generated procedural noise texture with customizable grain.
description: Static noise overlay using SVG feTurbulence filter for fractal noise generation. Fully customizable frequency, octaves, and slope for different grain appearances.
use_when: A lightweight, static noise texture overlay for subtle visual interest.
avoid_when: Accessibility contexts where visual noise may interfere with reading (high contrast requirements).
a11y: Decorative overlay marked pointer-events-none; does not interfere with interactive elements.
